_doc: W316 — THE ENUMERATION THAT REPLACES HAND-COUNTING.
Every entry is one SELECT, in server/**, from a table that carries tenant_id,
with no tenant_id predicate in its SQL. The fence FAILS on any statement not
listed here, so no NEW unscoped read can be added. It ALSO fails on any entry
here whose statement no longer exists or has changed, so this file cannot rot
into a permanent amnesty: fixing a read forces its entry to be removed.
READ THIS HONESTLY: 7 of these entries were reviewed one by one in W316 and
carry a specific reason. The remaining ones carry a generic reason and were
NOT individually reviewed. Listing a read here does NOT assert that it is safe.
It asserts that it exists, that it is known, and that the count can only fall.
The fence's declared limits are in the header of scripts/lint/tenantScopeFence.ts.
Reads built by the Drizzle query builder are invisible to it and are therefore
NOT in this file — their absence here is not evidence about them.
